g.text: Six lockers: each locker has its own code, no single shift
Routes test with six lockers (one item's locker sentence moved), held-out half. One shift vector added
at the bridge word (dose 2× a real change) from each start locker: lookups sent one locker on (%), 95%
intervals. Rule for a line: ≥ 25 from 4 of 5 start lockers, the random direction ≤ 5, the first PCA axis
in locker order. Fixed in advance.
